privacy.rights.title: Your rights
privacy.rights.text: Under the applicable conditions, you can request access, rectification, erasure, restriction or portability of your data, object to processing and give instructions about your data after death. Where processing relies on consent, you can withdraw it at any time without affecting earlier lawful processing. Contact contact@gostoa.dev or the registered office indicated above. You may lodge a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.scope.a: The new control plane remains private, as do some deployment resources. Check each component and version rather than extending the licence of published code to the whole product.
faq.cost.q: Can I use the published code without licence royalties?
faq.cost.a: The published licence permits use, modification and redistribution, including commercial use, subject to its terms. Operation and professional services may involve costs. It does not grant access to private components or a support commitment.
faq.deploy.a: Use the published code with the instructions and prerequisites for the relevant version. For private components, deployment and usage rights must be specified in the offer.
faq.offers.q: What do the commercial offers cover?
faq.offers.a: Sovereign iPaaS has a European positioning. Enterprise is tailored to your needs and quoted on request: contact us to define components, versions, rights and services. No price or service commitment is announced here.
faq.compliance.q: How does STOA support DORA / NIS2 / GDPR compliance?
faq.compliance.a: API governance, access policies and traceability can support your compliance work. The software alone does not make an organisation compliant. Applicable requirements and the assessment remain your responsibility.
faq.labs.a: STOA Labs is CAB Ingénierie’s consulting service. Access to public sources and community participation do not require purchasing a service. Commercial assistance does not change the licence of published code.

privacy.technical.title: Website operation and security
privacy.technical.text: Pages are stored and served by Scaleway from the Paris region (France). Edge Services logs process IP address, date and time, method, scheme, requested host and path, HTTP and TLS versions, status, content type, country and any security fields. Purposes: operation and security; basis: legitimate interest. Logs are retained for 7 days in Paris. Aggregate technical metrics (requests, cache, country) are retained for 31 days for the same purposes, without audience measurement. Object Storage access logs are disabled. No trackers, advertising, audience measurement, forms or newsletter.
privacy.recipients.title: Recipients
privacy.recipients.text: Authorised people at CAB Ingénierie handle enquiries. Scaleway SAS is the website host and processor. Cloudflare Inc. is a processor for DNS, the apex-domain redirect and the current email relay through Email Routing; Cloudflare is not the website host. Destination mailbox: [À COMPLÉTER : fournisseur et destinataires de la messagerie]. Until migration ends, Vercel may retain historical logs; projects and logs must be deleted after the switch.
privacy.transfers.title: Transfers outside the European Economic Area
privacy.transfers.text: Pages and their technical logs are intended to be located in Paris with Scaleway. Cloudflare Inc., a US company operating a global network, processes IP addresses and request headers for the apex-domain redirect (legitimate interest) and relays emails. [À COMPLÉTER : pays, garanties de transfert Cloudflare et messagerie, modalités d’obtention des garanties et confirmation des lieux de traitement par Scaleway]. No overall absence of transfers outside the EEA is asserted. Contact: contact@gostoa.dev.
